name: Sinanen Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Sinanen Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the energy and non-energy related businesses in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Energy wholesale and retail related businesses, Energy Solutions Business, and Non-energy business segments. It provides products and services related to energy, such as LP gas and kerosene, and electricity; and solutions, including renovation and housing equipment, as well as housework and house cleaning services.
